get.description: Every exam in the institution: title, owner, window and status only (admins).
Your attempt as you left it: same questions, order, answers and deadline (resume).

put.description:
Save a batch of answers. Each has a `client_revision`; an older or repeated one changes
nothing and is listed as stale. Refused with 409 `TIME_UP` after the deadline plus 60 s.
Mark a descriptive answer (0 to the question's points, optional feedback). Audited.
Save unsubmitted code for a coding question (one draft per language).

post.description:
Give extra minutes (reason required). Never past the window's end: 409
`WINDOW_ENDS_FIRST` says to move it first. The student sees it on the next heartbeat.

put.description: Mark or unmark a question for review.

post.description: End an attempt in progress now (reason required).

Every few seconds from the exam screen: status, deadline and server time (to react to
teacher actions and keep the timer honest), and a fresh token for proctoring uploads.

Run Code (PRD EXE-02, EXE-03): your code on the public test cases, or on `custom_input`.
Never graded. One at a time, 8 s apart, 20 per question; poll GET /runs/{id} for the result.

get.description:
Every submission for the question, newest first, with the one that counts (EXE-05). The
student's own, or the exam's owner (a teacher).

post.description:
Submit code for grading (PRD EXE-04): every test case. 5 s apart, up to the question's
limit; accepted until the deadline plus 60 s. Poll GET /submissions/{id} for the result.

get.description: The receipt of your submitted attempt (404 while it's still in progress).

post.description: Submit your exam. Safe to repeat: a second submit returns the same receipt.
Cancel an attempt (reason required). The student may then start the exam again.

get.description: The institution's audit log, newest first.

parameters.name: action

post.description: Set the first password from an invitation link. The account becomes active.
Who an invitation link is for (the activation page shows it). Doesn't use up the link.
Log in with email and password. Returns an access token; sets the refresh cookie.
End this browser's session. Works even if the access token has already expired.
End every session of the current user, on every device.

get.description: The logged-in user.

post.description: Set a new password from a reset link. Every session of the account is logged out.
Email a reset link if the account exists. The answer is the same either way.

schema.title: Response Request Password Reset Api V1 Auth Password Reset Request Post

post.description: Get a new access token using the refresh cookie. The cookie is replaced each time.

get.description: Your exams, newest first.

post.description: Create a draft. Settings not sent take their defaults (PRD § 6.3).

delete.description: Delete a draft. Published exams are archived instead, so their results stay.

patch.description:
Change settings. Once published only `close_at` may change; other fields return 409
`EXAM_PUBLISHED` naming the field.

get.description:
Scores, per-question numbers and, for coding, verdicts and pass rate per test case (low
ones flagged as possibly broken). Over fully graded attempts.
Students who may take the exam.

post.description:
Assign groups and/or students. A group adds each of its students; deactivated students are
skipped and students already assigned are left alone. Not for archived exams.

get.description:
Descriptive questions with the answers to mark. Students are "Student n" unless
`show_names` is set.

Every assigned student now: status, answered, time left, connection, answers waiting on
their device. The monitor page asks every 10 s.

post.description:
Take your own exam as a student would (draft or published). Replaces your previous
preview. Previews never count in results. Continue it with the usual /attempts endpoints.

Publish: refused with 409 `PUBLISH_BLOCKED` (listing each block) until the publish check
passes. Pins and locks question versions and freezes the exam. Afterwards only the window's
end and the assignments can change.

get.description: What blocks publishing and what is only a warning (PRD § 6.4), each naming what to fix.
The exam's questions in order, with the marks each is worth here.

put.description:
Replace the whole ordered list in one step: add, remove, reorder and set marks. Drafts
only. Your own questions and those shared with the institution can be used.

post.description:
Run every submission to one coding question again, with the question's current
(validated) test cases. 409 `NOT_VALIDATED` or `STILL_RUNNING`. Audited.

get.description:
Every attempt's score and grading status, and whether results can be released (and why
not).

post.description:
Release every computed result not released yet. 409 `RESULTS_NOT_READY` while an attempt
is in progress or still being graded.

get.description: One attempt in full: each answer with its score, the key, feedback and coding outcome.
Students who could be assigned to this exam, for the picker (name, email, roll no.).

schema.title: Response Student Choices Api V1 Exams  Exam Id  Student Choices Get

post.description:
Add students (ones already in the group are skipped). Nothing is added if any id is not an
active or invited student of the institution.

get.description: Liveness check. Returns OK when the API process is serving requests.

patch.description: Change evidence retention (7 to 90 days) or the default consent text. Audit-logged.

Replace the coding setup: formats, languages and starter code, limits, comparison, scoring.
Changes that affect results mark the question "needs validation" again.

post.description: Make your own private copy of a question you can see.

put.description: Set the order: every test case's id, once each.

schema.title: Response Reorder Test Cases Api V1 Questions  Question Id  Test Cases Order Put

post.description:
Run your reference solutions on every test case (PRD CQ-08). Returns at once with status
VALIDATING; the report fills in as each language finishes. 409 `VALIDATION_BLOCKED` while
something is missing (the coding view's `blocks`).

get.description: A run's status and, when done, its results (public cases only).
Your exams: available now, upcoming and completed.
One of your exams, for the instructions page.

post.description:
Start the exam, or get your attempt back if it's already started (safe to repeat).

Refused with 409 `EXAM_NOT_OPEN`, `EXAM_CLOSED`, `TOO_LATE_TO_START` (under 5 min left) or
`ALREADY_SUBMITTED`. The response has every question in your order, without answers.

get.description: The caller's past exams; scores only on released results.
A released result of the caller's. Not released (or not theirs): 404.
A submission's status and result: public cases in full, hidden ones as pass/fail only.

The caller's published exams with what needs doing (answers to mark, results to release),
and how many drafts and questions they have.

post.description: Upload an image for a question. It is checked, cleaned (EXIF removed) and stored as WebP.

get.description: Users of the institution, newest first.

post.description: Create a user and email them an invitation to set their password.

Check (`dry_run: true`) or import a CSV of users: email, full name, role, roll no.

Rows with errors are reported and not imported; existing emails are skipped. Each imported
user gets an invitation email. At most 1 MB and 2,000 users per file.

patch.description: Change name, email, role or roll number. A new email or role logs the user out everywhere.

post.description: Block login and end all sessions. Their past work is kept.
Email the user a password reset link. The admin never sees or sets the password.
Email a new invitation link (the old one stops working).
Clear a lockout caused by too many failed logins.
